result.finding: Data is classified as Internal/Public. Application stores photo images (BLOBs) and metadata — no PII, PHI, PCI, or financial data handled.
evidence: Photo entity fields: id (UUID), originalFileName, photoData (BLOB), storedFileName, filePath, fileSize, mimeType, uploadedAt, width, height — no personal identifiers
No email, phone, address, SSN, credit card, or health data fields in schema
No data classification annotations or policies documented
Database credentials (photoalbum/photoalbum) hardcoded in docker-compose.yml — treat as Confidential configuration
Photos themselves could contain sensitive personal content (user responsibility), but the app has no awareness of photo content
values: Photo binary data (BLOB): Internal/Public (no inherent PII, content-dependent)
Photo metadata (filename, size, dimensions, timestamp): Internal
Database credentials in environment variables: Confidential (configuration)
No PII, PHI, PCI, or financial data stored by the application
